title: Fabulas mitologicas del Siglo de Oro (ed. Antonio Rojas Castro, GitHub)
notes: Same project and repository as fabulasmito-gh: Antonio Rojas Castro's 2016 TEI-XML corpus of 26 Spanish Golden Age mythological fables (~150k words, CC BY 4.0), harvested here under origin 'Fábulas mitológicas: Barahona_acteon' with witnesses Barahona de Soto's Acteón and Vértumno, Bermúdez's Narciso, Bocángel's Leandro, Carrillo's Acis; the repo (live 200) is the canonical public source, with a companion publication in Studia Aurea (2017) and stylometry workshops built on this corpus. Corpus statistics (text, word and language counts, period) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.06 (in-core, including retained duplicates; harvested subset).
institution: Antonio Rojas Castro (Freie Universitaet Berlin / UNED)
